safeSAbiCatalog.description: Canonical machine-readable catalog of safer _s ABI facts. Consumed by -Wcplus-suggest-safe-s and verified against the shipped headers and the three SAFE_S_* docs by the ABI gate.

abiTags.preserving: ABI_PRESERVING_DROP_IN: identical C signature/source spelling; safe at an exported boundary.
abiTags.changing: ABI_CHANGING_ANNEX_K: changed parameters, return type or out-parameters; keep the legacy symbol at a public boundary.

malloc_s.reason: Identical parameter types and return type to the legacy C allocator; the suffix names a checked implementation, not a new ABI shape.
malloc_s.preconditions: Allocation is tracked; call through safe_c.h macros when replacing an existing call site, not at a public C export boundary.

cplus_fopen_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to fopen (FILE * / two const char *). This is the shipped adapter; the Annex K fopen_s (FILE ** + errno_t) is not shipped.
cplus_fopen_s.preconditions: Stream handles are owned by the caller; close with cplus_fclose_s or fclose consistently.

cplus_fclose_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to fclose; adds double-close detection without changing the C ABI.
cplus_fclose_s.preconditions: Do not close the same stream twice.

cplus_printf_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to printf; rejects non-literal formats and %n at compile time.
cplus_printf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters.

cplus_fprintf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters.

cplus_scanf_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to scanf at the C ABI level; the Annex K scanf_s adds size arguments for %s/%c and is not shipped.
cplus_scanf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters.

cplus_fscanf_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to fscanf at the C ABI level.
cplus_fscanf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters.

cplus_sscanf_s.reason: Type-for-type identical to sscanf at the C ABI level.
cplus_sscanf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters.

cplus_snprintf_s.legacySignature: int snprintf(char *dest, size_t n, const char *fmt, ...)
cplus_snprintf_s.reason: size_t and rsize_t are the same underlying type on supported LP64 hosts and the parameter order/return type match snprintf/vsnprintf; no errno_t is introduced.
cplus_snprintf_s.preconditions: Format must be a literal (or already trusted); %n is rejected by the compiled adapters. dmax must be the real destination capacity.
